topics.title: Davina and Howard’s Unconventional Attraction

topics.title: Davina's Unconventional Date

They engage in awkward conversation about his lifestyle, religion (Lutheran), attempts to impress her with romantic phrases while also attempting to drug him, culminating in an uncomfortable exchange regarding his age and living situation.

topics.title: Camp Mill Records Sale

topics.title: Unsolicited Opinions and Weather Reports
topics.summary: A caller expresses frustration with taxes and authority while requesting a song. The broadcast then transitions to news reports covering the Falklands conflict, drunk driving statistics, NBA basketball, and weather forecasts before concluding with a melancholic musical performance about loneliness.

topics.title: Repetitive Musical Interlude with TV Updates

topics.title: California College Course & Sexual Experiences
topics.summary: A radio host discusses a California State University, Long Beach psychology course that offered students credit for sexual experiences, including attending gay bars and orgy attendance. The university subsequently backed away from the policy due to religious objections.
